entry.title: ProstoCAD 0.12.1: Smooth sketching, points easy to catch, and Extrude Cut fixed
entry.content:
Added

  • Drawing in a sketch keeps up with the mouse: no more lag behind the pointer. Points are easier to catch on a Retina screen, too.
  • A rectangle shows its diagonals dashed while you draw it, then keeps a centre point: put it on the origin and the rectangle is centred.

Fixed

  • Extrude ▸ Cut of a profile beside the part cuts the first time (before, it took Intersect and then Cut).
  • A rectangle's centre point goes onto an axis with Coincident: its constraint icon no longer takes the click.
